secrets.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
secrets.description: AWS Access Key ID for S3 image uploads. Obtain from AWS IAM console.

secrets.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
secrets.description: AWS Secret Access Key for S3 image uploads. Obtain from AWS IAM console.

secrets.name: AWS_S3_BUCKET
secrets.description: S3 bucket name for storing equipment images. Create a bucket in AWS S3 console.

secrets.name: AWS_S3_REGION
secrets.description: AWS region for the S3 bucket (e.g. us-east-1, sa-east-1).
